_note: 學習路徑內容建置第12批 #6／6：授與動詞雙受詞的被動（eng.t_adv.voice.ditransitive，學測級／高階）。give／send／offer／tell／show 等授與動詞有兩個受詞（間接受詞＝人、直接受詞＝物）：They gave me a book。可有兩種被動：(1) 以人當主詞 I was given a book；(2) 以物當主詞 A book was given to me（物當主詞時人前加 to）。兩式皆合法，故每題以『已給定主詞』鎖單一轉換（人→form1、物→form2）。誘答以『缺 be／用主動/進行式／主詞一致錯／介系詞錯』鎖唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix vdt_）。

units.title_zh: 授與動詞雙受詞的被動（I was given a book）
units.can_do: 我能把 give／send／offer／tell／show 等有雙受詞（人＋物）的句子改成被動，知道有兩種轉換：以人當主詞（I was given a book）或以物當主詞（A book was given to me，人前加 to），兩種都用 be ＋ 過去分詞。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: Verbs like give, send, offer, tell and show take two objects — an indirect object (a person) and a direct object (a thing): 'They gave me a book.'
claims.verification_ref: give/send/offer/tell/show 有雙受詞（人＋物）；They gave me a book；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Such sentences have two passive forms: the person as subject ('I was given a book') or the thing as subject ('A book was given to me'); both are correct.
claims.verification_ref: 兩種被動：人當主詞 I was given a book／物當主詞 A book was given to me，皆合法；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When the thing is the subject, we usually add 'to' before the person: 'A book was given to me', 'A letter was sent to Mary.'
claims.verification_ref: 物當主詞時人前加 to；A book was given to me；A letter was sent to Mary；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Each passive uses be + past participle (was given, was sent, was offered, were shown), just like other passives.
claims.verification_ref: 兩式都用 be ＋ 過去分詞：was given/was sent/was offered/were shown；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: Some verbs, like give, send, offer, tell, and show, can take two objects: a person (the indirect object) and a thing (the direct object). They gave me a book. Here 'me' is the person and 'a book' is the thing.
teach.zh_hint: 有些動詞像 give（給）、send（寄）、offer（提供）、tell（告訴）、show（給……看）可以同時帶『兩個』受詞：一個是『人』（間接受詞），一個是『物』（直接受詞）。They gave me a book.（他們給了我一本書。me＝人，a book＝物。）

teach.body: I was given a book by my teacher.
teach.zh_hint: 我被老師給了一本書。以『人』我當主詞。

teach.body: Because there are two objects, there can be two passive forms: (1) make the person the subject: I was given a book. (2) make the thing the subject: A book was given to me. Both are correct.
teach.zh_hint: 因為有兩個受詞，所以可以有『兩種』被動：(1) 把『人』放到主詞：I was given a book.（我拿到一本書。）(2) 把『物』放到主詞：A book was given to me.（一本書被給了我。）兩種都正確。

teach.body: A book was given to me.
teach.zh_hint: 一本書被給了我。以『物』當主詞時，人前面加 to。

teach.body: Key point: when the thing is the subject, we usually add 'to' before the person (A book was given to me). Both passive forms use be + past participle: was given, was sent, was offered, were shown.
teach.zh_hint: 重點：以『物』當主詞時，人的前面通常要加 to（A book was given to me）。而且兩種被動都用 be ＋ 過去分詞：was given、was sent、was offered、were shown。

teach.body: She was sent a letter yesterday.
teach.zh_hint: 她昨天收到一封信。以『人』她當主詞。

practice.stem: 把 'The teacher gave Tom a prize' 改被動（以 Tom 當主詞）：Tom ____ a prize.

distractor_rationales.gave: gave 是主動，意思變成 Tom 給別人；被動要 was ＋ 過去分詞 given。
distractor_rationales.was giving: was giving 是過去進行主動，意思不對；要被動 was given。
distractor_rationales.given: 缺 be 動詞；要 was given。

practice.feedback: 以人當主詞：Tom was given a prize（was ＋ 過去分詞 given）。

practice.stem: 把 'They sent Mary a letter' 改被動（以 a letter 當主詞）：A letter ____ to Mary.

distractor_rationales.sent: 缺 be 動詞；被動要 was sent。
distractor_rationales.sends: sends 是主動現在式，意思不對；要被動 was sent。
distractor_rationales.was sending: was sending 是過去進行主動；要被動 was sent。

practice.feedback: 以物當主詞：A letter was sent to Mary（was ＋ 過去分詞 sent）。

practice.stem: 填入正確的介系詞：A book was given ____ me.（一本書被給了我）

distractor_rationales.for: give 用 to 帶出對象，不用 for；A book was given to me。
distractor_rationales.at: at 表地點/時間，意思不合。
distractor_rationales.by: by 帶出『動作者』（by my teacher），不是收受的人；收受者前用 to。

practice.feedback: give 以物當主詞時，人前加 to：A book was given to me。

practice.stem: 把 'They offered her a job' 改成『以她當主詞』的被動，哪一句正確？

被動要用過去分詞 offered，不是原形 offer。
is 後面要過去分詞 offered，且時態應為過去 was。
主詞 She 配單數 was，不是 were。

practice.feedback: 以人當主詞：She was offered a job（was ＋ 過去分詞 offered）。

practice.stem: 'I was given a present' 的意思是？
practice.answer: 有人給了我一個禮物（我收到禮物）
options: 有人給了我一個禮物（我收到禮物）

distractor_rationales.我給了別人一個禮物: was given 是被動，我是『收到』的一方，不是給出的人。
distractor_rationales.我送出了一個禮物: send 出禮物是主動；was given 是被動、我是收受者。
distractor_rationales.我拿走了一個禮物: take 走是主動；was given 表我被給予、是收受者。

practice.feedback: I was given a present＝被動，我是收到禮物的那一方。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: I was given a book by my teacher.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：was given 有沒有寫對、a book、by my teacher 有沒有漏、句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。be ＋ 過去分詞連貫、句尾下收。

lines.text: We were shown the new classroom.
lines.intonation: We were shown 連貫、the new classroom 句尾下收

lines.text: A present was given to the winner.
lines.intonation: A present was given 連貫、to the winner 句尾下收
